# laravelforge_server_php_fpm_config (Data Source)

Fetches the php-fpm configuration for a given PHP version on a Laravel Forge server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `php_version` (String) PHP version key whose php-fpm configuration is fetched (e.g. `php82`).
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the PHP version belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `configuration` (String) The php-fpm configuration content.
